questions.question: Clarify the scope of the priority claims for the popular physics and mathematics journal and the first Russian courses on Lobachevsky geometry and the foundations of geometry.

localizations.source: Clarify the scope of the priority claims for the popular physics and mathematics journal and the first Russian courses on Lobachevsky geometry and the foundations of geometry.
localizations.ru: Уточнить рамки утверждений о первом научно-популярном физико-математическом журнале и первых российских курсах геометрии Лобачевского и оснований геометрии.

questions.resolution: The absolute priority claims were qualified: the Bulletin is now one of Russia’s earliest journals of its kind, and Kagan is described as among the first to teach the corresponding university courses.

questions.question: Kagan’s source dates the First All-Russian Congress of Mathematics Teachers to December 1911–January 1912, while the Bobynin article (#366) gives late 1912–early 1913. Check the original congress source and agree the date; both source texts are retained for now.

localizations.source: Kagan’s source dates the First All-Russian Congress of Mathematics Teachers to December 1911–January 1912, while the Bobynin article (#366) gives late 1912–early 1913. Check the original congress source and agree the date; both source texts are retained for now.
localizations.ru: У Кагана Первый Всероссийский съезд преподавателей математики датирован декабрём 1911 — январём 1912, а в переносимом очерке о Бобынине (#366) указан конец 1912 — начало 1913. Сверить первоисточник и согласовать дату; оба исходных текста пока сохранены.

questions.resolution: The supported date of the First All-Russian Congress of Mathematics Teachers, December 1911–January 1912, is retained. The discrepancy belongs to another article and does not alter this edition.
